summary: Brookfield Corporation filed a Form 6-K on 2026-09-21, attaching a preliminary Canadian term sheet (Exhibit 99.1) for a benchmark SEC-registered offering of senior unsecured notes due 2031 by its subsidiary, Brookfield Finance Inc., fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Brookfield Corporation. Terms remain bracketed, with expected settlement on 2026-09-23 (T+2) and use of proceeds for general corporate purposes. Affiliates of Brookfield Wealth Solutions Ltd. and other institutional investors may be sold notes without underwriting discount. Joint book-running managers include Deutsche Bank, BofA Securities, Mizuho and MUFG. As an ordinary debt shelf takedown, this is not a special situation; watch pricing, spread tightening and investor demand.
